# axe-core 4.13.0 (vendored)

`axe.min.js` is the unmodified minified build of [axe-core](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core) 4.13.0, fetched from the npm registry (`axe-core-4.13.0.tgz`) and copied here so that `scripts/a11y-check.mjs` can inject it into the prototype under Playwright without a package install. Licence: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see `LICENSE` beside it). The prototype itself stays dependency-free; this file is used only by the test harness.
